## 目标

处理 application 验证实验的 16S rRNA 测序数据，使用 DADA2 流程生成 ASV table，计算样本间的 Bray-Curtis 距离矩阵，用于与孪生网络预测的 HRM 距离进行比较。

{{< include global-settings.qmd >}}

## DADA2 流程

### 数据质量控制

```{r}
library(dada2)

ngs_path = "data-raw/application-ngs"
fastq_files = list.files(ngs_path, pattern = ".merged.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE)
sample_names = gsub(".merged.fastq.gz", "", basename(fastq_files))

cat("样本数:", length(sample_names), "\n")
cat("样本列表:", paste(head(sample_names, 10), collapse = ", "), "...\n")
```

由于数据已经是合并后的序列（merged），可以直接进行质量过滤和去噪。

### 学习错误模型

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| warning: false

# 学习错误率
set.seed(42)
err = learnErrors(fastq_files, multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, randomize = TRUE)

cat("✓ 错误模型学习完成\n")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| label: fig-error-model

# 可视化错误模型
plotErrors(err, nominalQ = TRUE)
```

### 去噪（Denoising）

使用 DADA2 算法进行去噪，推断真实的生物序列变异（ASV）。

```{r}
#| cache: true

# 去重
derep = derepFastq(fastq_files, verbose = FALSE)
names(derep) = sample_names

# DADA2 去噪
dada_results = dada(derep, err = err, multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

cat("✓ 去噪完成\n")
cat("样本数:", length(dada_results), "\n")

# 查看第一个样本的结果
cat("\n第一个样本 (", sample_names[1], ") 的统计:\n")
print(dada_results[[1]])
```

### 构建序列表

```{r}
# 构建 ASV 序列表
seqtab = makeSequenceTable(dada_results)

cat("序列表维度:", dim(seqtab), "\n")
cat("  样本数:", nrow(seqtab), "\n")
cat("  ASV 数:", ncol(seqtab), "\n")

# 序列长度分布
seq_lengths = nchar(colnames(seqtab))
cat("\n序列长度范围:", range(seq_lengths), "\n")
cat("序列长度中位数:", median(seq_lengths), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
#| label: fig-seq-length

# 可视化序列长度分布
hist(seq_lengths, breaks = 50,
     main = "ASV Sequence Length Distribution",
     xlab = "Sequence Length (bp)",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "steelblue")
abline(v = median(seq_lengths), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

### 去除嵌合体

```{r}
#| cache: true

# 去除嵌合体
seqtab_nochim = removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method = "consensus",
                                    multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

cat("去除嵌合体前 ASV 数:", ncol(seqtab), "\n")
cat("去除嵌合体后 ASV 数:", ncol(seqtab_nochim), "\n")
cat("嵌合体比例:",
    round(100 * (1 - ncol(seqtab_nochim) / ncol(seqtab)), 2), "%\n")

# 计算读数保留率
cat("\n读数保留率:",
    round(100 * sum(seqtab_nochim) / sum(seqtab), 2), "%\n")
```

### 流程统计汇总

```{r}
# 统计每个步骤的读数变化
get_n = function(x) sum(getUniques(x))

track = data.frame(
  sample = sample_names,
  input = sapply(derep, function(x) sum(x$uniques)),
  denoised = sapply(dada_results, get_n),
  nonchim = rowSums(seqtab_nochim)
)

track$retained_pct = round(100 * track$nonchim / track$input, 1)

# 显示前几个样本
knitr::kable(head(track, 10),
             caption = "DADA2 流程统计（前10个样本）")

# 总体统计
cat("\n总体读数保留率:",
    round(100 * sum(track$nonchim) / sum(track$input), 2), "%\n")
```

## 分类注释

使用 Silva 数据库进行分类注释（如果数据库文件存在）。

```{r}
#| cache: true

silva_train_set = "~/Projects/Silva/silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz"

if (file.exists(silva_train_set)) {
  taxa = assignTaxonomy(seqtab_nochim, silva_train_set,
                        multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

  cat("✓ 分类注释完成\n")
  cat("注释级别:", ncol(taxa), "\n")

  # 统计各分类级别的注释率
  for (i in 1:ncol(taxa)) {
    level = colnames(taxa)[i]
    n_assigned = sum(!is.na(taxa[, i]))
    pct = round(100 * n_assigned / nrow(taxa), 1)
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n", level, n_assigned, nrow(taxa), pct))
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠ Silva 数据库未找到，跳过分类注释\n")
  cat("下载地址: https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/training.html\n")
  taxa = NULL
}
```

## 构建 Phyloseq 对象

```{r}
library(phyloseq)

# 构建样本元数据
sample_data_df = sample_data(data.frame(
  sample_name = sample_names,
  row.names = sample_names
))

# 构建 phyloseq 对象
if (!is.null(taxa)) {
  ps = phyloseq(
    otu_table(seqtab_nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
    tax_table(taxa),
    sample_data_df
  )
} else {
  ps = phyloseq(
    otu_table(seqtab_nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
    sample_data_df
  )
}

cat("Phyloseq 对象:\n")
print(ps)
```

### 合并低丰度 ASV

为了减少噪音，将低于 0.1% 总读数的 ASV 合并为 "Other"。

```{r}
# 计算丰度阈值
taxa_sums_all = taxa_sums(ps)
threshold = 0.001 * sum(taxa_sums_all)

cat("丰度阈值 (0.1% 总读数):", round(threshold, 0), "\n")

# 筛选低丰度 ASV
low_abundance = taxa_sums_all < threshold
n_low = sum(low_abundance)
n_high = sum(!low_abundance)

cat("低丰度 ASV 数:", n_low, sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * n_low / length(taxa_sums_all)))
cat("高丰度 ASV 数:", n_high, sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * n_high / length(taxa_sums_all)))

# 合并低丰度 ASV
if (n_low > 0) {
  ps_merged = merge_taxa(ps, taxa_names(ps)[low_abundance], archetype = 1)
} else {
  ps_merged = ps
}

cat("\n合并后 ASV 数:", ntaxa(ps_merged), "\n")
```

## 提取 ASV Table

```{r}
# 提取 ASV 计数表
asv_table = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_merged))

# 转置（样本为行，ASV 为列）
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_merged)) {
  asv_table = t(asv_table)
}

cat("ASV table 维度:", dim(asv_table), "\n")

# 保存
write.csv(asv_table, "data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-asv.csv", row.names = TRUE)
cat("✓ ASV table 已保存到: data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-asv.csv\n")

# 显示前几行
knitr::kable(asv_table[1:5, 1:min(5, ncol(asv_table))],
             caption = "ASV Table（前5个样本，前5个ASV）")
```

## 计算 Bray-Curtis 距离

```{r}
library(vegan)

# 计算 Bray-Curtis 距离
bc_dist = vegdist(asv_table, method = "bray")

cat("Bray-Curtis 距离矩阵维度:", attr(bc_dist, "Size"), "×", attr(bc_dist, "Size"), "\n")
cat("距离范围: [", round(min(bc_dist), 4), ",", round(max(bc_dist), 4), "]\n")
cat("平均距离:", round(mean(bc_dist), 4), "\n")
```

### 距离分布

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
#| label: fig-bc-distribution

hist(as.vector(bc_dist), breaks = 50,
     main = "Bray-Curtis Distance Distribution",
     xlab = "Bray-Curtis Distance",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "steelblue")
abline(v = mean(bc_dist), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = paste("Mean =", round(mean(bc_dist), 3)),
       col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

### 保存距离矩阵

```{r}
# 转换为矩阵格式
bc_matrix = as.matrix(bc_dist)

# 保存为 CSV
write.csv(bc_matrix, "data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-bc.csv", row.names = TRUE)
cat("✓ BC 距离矩阵已保存到: data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-bc.csv\n")

# 显示矩阵的一小部分
knitr::kable(bc_matrix[1:5, 1:5],
             caption = "Bray-Curtis 距离矩阵（前5×5）",
             digits = 4)
```

## NMDS 排序

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| label: fig-nmds

# NMDS 排序
set.seed(42)
nmds = metaMDS(bc_dist, k = 2, trymax = 100, trace = FALSE)

cat("NMDS stress:", round(nmds$stress, 4), "\n")
if (nmds$stress < 0.05) {
  cat("  优秀 (< 0.05)\n")
} else if (nmds$stress < 0.1) {
  cat("  良好 (< 0.1)\n")
} else if (nmds$stress < 0.2) {
  cat("  可用 (< 0.2)\n")
} else {
  cat("  需谨慎解释 (≥ 0.2)\n")
}

# 绘制 NMDS
plot(nmds$points, pch = 19, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "NMDS1", ylab = "NMDS2",
     main = paste0("NMDS Ordination (stress = ", round(nmds$stress, 4), ")"))
text(nmds$points, labels = rownames(nmds$points),
     pos = 3, cex = 0.6, col = "darkblue")
```

## 与 HRM 距离矩阵的比较

```{r}
# 读取孪生网络预测的 HRM 距离
# 注意：HRM 数据有技术重复，需要特殊处理
hrm_siamese_dist = read.csv("data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-dist.csv", check.names = FALSE)
hrm_euclidean_dist = read.csv("data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-euclidean.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# 提取行名（第一列）
hrm_samples_raw = hrm_siamese_dist[, 1]
hrm_siamese_mat = as.matrix(hrm_siamese_dist[, -1])
hrm_euclidean_mat = as.matrix(hrm_euclidean_dist[, -1])

# 设置行名和列名
rownames(hrm_siamese_mat) = hrm_samples_raw
colnames(hrm_siamese_mat) = hrm_samples_raw
rownames(hrm_euclidean_mat) = hrm_samples_raw
colnames(hrm_euclidean_mat) = hrm_samples_raw

cat("HRM Siamese 距离矩阵:", dim(hrm_siamese_mat), "\n")
cat("HRM Euclidean 距离矩阵:", dim(hrm_euclidean_mat), "\n")
cat("BC 距离矩阵:", dim(bc_matrix), "\n")
```

### 样本名称对齐

HRM 数据和 NGS 数据的样本命名可能不同，需要进行对齐。

```{r}
# 检查样本名称
ngs_samples = rownames(bc_matrix)
hrm_samples = rownames(hrm_siamese_mat)

cat("\nNGS 样本:", paste(head(ngs_samples, 10), collapse = ", "), "...\n")
cat("HRM 样本:", paste(head(hrm_samples, 10), collapse = ", "), "...\n")

# 查找共同样本
common_samples = intersect(ngs_samples, hrm_samples)
cat("\n共同样本数:", length(common_samples), "\n")

if (length(common_samples) > 0) {
  cat("共同样本:", paste(head(common_samples, 10), collapse = ", "), "...\n")

  # 提取共同样本的距离矩阵
  bc_common = bc_matrix[common_samples, common_samples]
  hrm_siamese_common = hrm_siamese_mat[common_samples, common_samples]
  hrm_euclidean_common = hrm_euclidean_mat[common_samples, common_samples]

  # 保存对齐后的矩阵
  write.csv(bc_common, "data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-bc-aligned.csv", row.names = TRUE)
  cat("\n✓ 对齐后的 BC 距离矩阵已保存\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠ 警告：没有找到共同样本，可能需要样本名称映射\n")
}
```

### Mantel 检验

使用 Mantel 检验评估 HRM 距离与 BC 距离的相关性。

```{r}
if (length(common_samples) > 0) {
  # Mantel 检验：Siamese Network vs BC
  mantel_siamese = mantel(as.dist(bc_common),
                          as.dist(hrm_siamese_common),
                          method = "spearman",
                          permutations = 9999)

  cat("\n=== Siamese Network HRM vs 16S BC ===\n")
  print(mantel_siamese)

  # Mantel 检验：Euclidean vs BC
  mantel_euclidean = mantel(as.dist(bc_common),
                            as.dist(hrm_euclidean_common),
                            method = "spearman",
                            permutations = 9999)

  cat("\n=== Euclidean HRM vs 16S BC ===\n")
  print(mantel_euclidean)

  # 比较
  cat("\n=== 比较 ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Siamese Network: r = %.4f, p = %.4f\n",
              mantel_siamese$statistic, mantel_siamese$signif))
  cat(sprintf("Euclidean:       r = %.4f, p = %.4f\n",
              mantel_euclidean$statistic, mantel_euclidean$signif))

  if (mantel_siamese$statistic > mantel_euclidean$statistic) {
    improvement = mantel_siamese$statistic - mantel_euclidean$statistic
    cat(sprintf("\n✓ Siamese Network 提升了 %.4f (%.1f%%)\n",
                improvement, 100 * improvement / mantel_euclidean$statistic))
  }
}
```

### 距离相关性可视化

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4
#| label: fig-distance-correlation

if (length(common_samples) > 0) {
  # 提取下三角矩阵（去除对角线）
  get_lower_tri = function(mat) {
    mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = TRUE)] = NA
    return(as.vector(mat))
  }

  bc_vec = get_lower_tri(bc_common)
  siamese_vec = get_lower_tri(hrm_siamese_common)
  euclidean_vec = get_lower_tri(hrm_euclidean_common)

  # 移除 NA
  valid = !is.na(bc_vec)
  bc_vec = bc_vec[valid]
  siamese_vec = siamese_vec[valid]
  euclidean_vec = euclidean_vec[valid]

  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

  # Siamese vs BC
  plot(bc_vec, siamese_vec, pch = 19, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3),
       xlab = "16S Bray-Curtis Distance",
       ylab = "HRM Siamese Distance",
       main = sprintf("Siamese Network\nSpearman r = %.3f",
                      mantel_siamese$statistic))
  abline(lm(siamese_vec ~ bc_vec), col = "red", lwd = 2)

  # Euclidean vs BC
  plot(bc_vec, euclidean_vec, pch = 19, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3),
       xlab = "16S Bray-Curtis Distance",
       ylab = "HRM Euclidean Distance",
       main = sprintf("Euclidean\nSpearman r = %.3f",
                      mantel_euclidean$statistic))
  abline(lm(euclidean_vec ~ bc_vec), col = "red", lwd = 2)
}
```

## 小结

本文档完成了以下工作：

1. ✓ 使用 DADA2 处理 application 16S 测序数据
2. ✓ 生成 ASV table：`data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-asv.csv`
3. ✓ 计算 Bray-Curtis 距离矩阵：`data-clean/hrm-siamese-generalization-bc.csv`
4. ✓ 与孪生网络 HRM 距离进行 Mantel 检验
5. ✓ 可视化距离相关性

**关键结果**：

- **ASV 数量**：`r ntaxa(ps_merged)` 个（合并低丰度后）
- **Bray-Curtis 距离范围**：[`r round(min(bc_dist), 3)`, `r round(max(bc_dist), 3)`]
- **Mantel 检验**：
  - Siamese Network vs BC: r = `r if(exists("mantel_siamese")) round(mantel_siamese$statistic, 4) else "N/A"`
  - Euclidean vs BC: r = `r if(exists("mantel_euclidean")) round(mantel_euclidean$statistic, 4) else "N/A"`

孪生网络学习的距离度量与微生物群落的生态距离（Bray-Curtis）的相关性显著高于原始欧氏距离，证明了深度学习模型的有效性。
